title: Lisbon, a room
logline: Behind the tram on the 2001 postcard, a room he invents: shutters, a tile floor, her coat on a chair — the only thing in any of these rooms that's hers. The card said Barcelona.

panels.composition: A room behind the postcard: tall shutters half open onto a Lisbon hill with the tram from the card small in the street below; a tile floor in a pattern he draws with too much care; a chair with a coat over it — the gray coat is not hers; this one is green. On the floor by the chair, a postcard of the same view, the room drawing its own source.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a bright room with tall half-open shutters looking down a Lisbon hill where a yellow tram passes, an ornately patterned tile floor, a wooden chair with a green coat over its back, a postcard of the same view lying on the floor, nobody present, no words
image.notes: Green coat, not gray. Gray was Julian's.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: A room built behind a postcard. The coat is green.
